name: cf_cut_hug_s2
negative: torn edges, painterly, gradient shading, gradient, 3D render, paper sculpture, origami, glossy, photorealistic, photograph, miniature model, text, letters, watermark, faces on objects, eyes on objects, wavy decorative bands, thick white outline, colored shadow, airbrushing, painted texture, felt, corrugated cardboard, perspective, depth of field, frame, border, vignette, scary, creepy
prompt: Hand-cut layered cardstock paper art in the style of the reference images. Every shape is cut from colored cardstock with crisp clean edges, flat saturated colors with at most two tones per shape, no gradients, no outlines. Three to five depth layers stacked one in front of another (far sky and hills, middle shapes, foreground); each sheet sits slightly above the one behind it and casts a soft realistic drop shadow toward the lower right, light coming from the upper left. Fine paper grain over everything. Sky, hills and tree masses are cut as cloud-shaped scalloped sheets. Rich but uncluttered: two to four meaningful elements only. Objects, buildings and props have NO faces and NO eyes. No text. One warm picture-book illustration filling the entire image edge to edge, no frame, no border, kid-friendly and never scary. The characters have simple friendly faces (round dot eyes, small smile, pink cheeks); objects and props have no faces or eyes. Cozy comfort moment: in a rainy cloud factory a small friendly lightning bolt flashes at the window, and the three children and the dog squeeze together in one big warm hug in the middle with eyes shut, the baby hiding her face in the dog's neck, a tiny dark-grey baby cloud peeking shyly over their heads, soft blue raindrops. Gentle and safe, not scary. The three children are exactly: The big sister (about 4 years old), a Korean girl: shoulder-length soft dark brown hair with straight bangs; she wears a long-sleeved top and long pants made of bold HORIZONTAL stripes in red, yellow and light blue, each stripe holding a tiny simple motif — red cherries, orange carrots, small white bunny heads — with dark-green cuffs and neckline trim, and white sneakers. NO pink, NO text. The little brother (about 3 years old), a Korean boy: a short black bowl-cut with straight bangs; he wears bright sky-blue pajamas (long-sleeved top and long pants) with a yellow rim at the neck, cuffs and hems, covered with simple yellow-and-black striped cartoon bees with small white wings and little red honey pots, and dark blue sneakers with velcro straps. NO text on the clothes. The baby sister (about 1.5 years old), a Korean toddler: a short black bob with a straight blunt fringe, a chubby round face; she wears a cream-white blouse with puffy sleeves, a BIG mustard-yellow flat sailor collar and mustard cuffs, pale butter-yellow short leggings, and BARE feet with no shoes.  The dog is a small slim cream-white terrier mix: ONE ear white with tan spots and pink inside, the OTHER ear solid tan half-folded, no clothes, no collar.  Exactly three children and one dog (plus the story props named), no other people.
